strava.auth: OAuth 2.0 authorization code; access token ~6h, refresh token; client secret server-side
strava.webhooks: One push subscription per app; object_type activity|athlete; aspect_type create|update|delete; must 200 within 2s; deauth = athlete update authorized:false
data_restrictions: Display Strava Data only to the user who provided it, even if public on Strava (Agreement 2.3 / Policy 2.3, 6.1; since Nov 2024)
No use in development, training, evaluation or operation of any AI Application incl. embeddings/RAG and derived/aggregated/anonymized data (Policy 5.3)
No processing for analytics, insights or product improvement (Policy 5.4)
Cache no longer than 7 days (Policy 6.2)
Delete within 30 days on user request/deauthorization/account deletion and certify in writing (Policy 7.4)
No use competitive to Strava (Policy 5.2)
Standard tier requires active Strava subscription (Policy 3.3; effective 2026-06-01 new / 2026-06-30 existing per secondary sources)
strava.attribution: Official Connect with Strava button; 'Powered by Strava' or 'Compatible with Strava'; 'View on Strava' links (bold/underline/#FC5200); no Strava in app name/icon
strava.rn_library: No official SDK; expo-auth-session 57.0.13 (2026-09-24) or react-native-app-auth 8.4.1 (2026-07-06) + Supabase Edge Functions
strava.approval_required: Athlete capacity 1 by default; self-serve upgrade to 10; review for up to 9,999 (Standard); Extended Access 10,000+ case-by-case
strava.notes: API Agreement and API Policy both effective 2026-06-01. UNVERIFIED: exact Policy 6.1 wording (summariser output garbled re 9,999 threshold); subscription price (~$11.99/mo per third parties); club endpoint removals 2026-09-01 and api-v3 base URL / 2027-06-01 migration (secondary source Terra). Legal review needed on whether derived game XP counts as Strava Data.

apple_healthkit.auth: On-device per-type read/write authorization; NSHealthShareUsageDescription / NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription; read-denial not revealed to app
apple_healthkit.webhooks: Background delivery via HKObserverQuery + enableBackgroundDelivery; entitlement com.apple.developer.healthkit.background-delivery; some types max hourly on iOS
data_restrictions: 5.1.3(i): no use/disclosure for advertising, marketing or use-based data mining other than improving health management or health research, and only with permission; disclose specific data collected
5.1.3(ii): no false data written to HealthKit; no personal health info in iCloud
2.5.1: HealthKit only for health/fitness purposes, integration stated in app description
5.1.2(i): disclose and get explicit permission before sharing personal data with third-party AI
apple_healthkit.attribution: Apple Health marketing guidelines apply if using Apple Health imagery (UNVERIFIED, not fetched)
apple_healthkit.rn_library: @kingstinct/react-native-healthkit 16.0.0 (2026-09-18, actively maintained, Nitro, Expo config plugin with background option, workout routes). react-native-health 1.19.0 (2024-10-15, feature freeze pending Swift rewrite). No official Expo HealthKit module found. Requires dev client/EAS, not Expo Go.
apple_healthkit.approval_required: No partner approval; App Store review of health usage
apple_healthkit.notes: Workouts, HR, energy, distance, HKWorkoutRoute locations with altitude. Guidelines page shows no last-updated date.

google_health_connect.auth: On-device runtime permissions per data type; READ_HEALTH_DATA_HISTORY for >30 days before grant; READ_HEALTH_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND for background; READ_EXERCISE_ROUTES
google_health_connect.rate_limits: Undisclosed quotas; handle IllegalStateException with backoff; paginate with pageToken
google_health_connect.webhooks: None; poll via WorkManager (e.g. hourly) or changes token
data_restrictions: Play Console health permissions declaration with per-permission justification
Permitted use cases include fitness/wellness and health-integrated games
No sale/transfer to advertisers or data brokers; no ad use; no third-party sharing without consent
Privacy policy must cover collection, use, retention, deletion, security
Default 30-day history limit before first permission grant
Exercise routes from other apps may require per-session consent and cannot be read in background
google_health_connect.rn_library: react-native-health-connect 4.1.3 (2026-08-06; built-in Expo config plugin since v4; compileSdk 36, minSdk 26; EAS build). expo-health-connect 0.1.1 is legacy.
google_health_connect.approval_required: Play Console health declaration review (~up to 7 days + 5-7 business days whitelist per library README)
google_health_connect.notes: Google Fit APIs supported until end of 2026, no new signups since 2024-05-01 (FAQ last updated 2026-08-21). Do not build on Google Fit.

garmin_connect.auth: OAuth 2.0 PKCE (legacy Health API used OAuth 1.0a); token lifetime ~3 months per secondary source (UNVERIFIED)
garmin_connect.webhooks: Push (data POSTed on device sync) or ping/pull; backfill supported; evaluation environment
data_restrictions: Enterprise use only; personal use not supported
Some metrics may require license fee or minimum device order for commercial use
Attribution required on any display/distribution of Garmin device-sourced data (Agreement 6.4, China-region variant FRM-0952 Rev. B)
AI Transparency Statement with explicit opt-in consent required if user data used for AI training/processing (China-region variant)
Retention/deletion terms UNVERIFIED
garmin_connect.attribution: Garmin API Brand Guidelines: attribution on title-level displays, secondary screens, exported data, derived data (incl. analytics/ML/AI inputs), social sharing
garmin_connect.rn_library: None needed (cloud-to-cloud); expo-auth-session for PKCE + Supabase webhook endpoint. react-native-garmin-connect 0.3.0 (2024-07-30) unofficial/stale.
garmin_connect.approval_required: Yes; application reviewed in ~2 business days; integration 1-4 weeks
garmin_connect.notes: APIs: Health, Activity (FIT/GPX/TCX with GPS/HR/elevation), Women's Health, Training, Courses. Global agreement text not verified; only China-region PDF was reachable.

fitbit_web_api.auth: Legacy Fitbit OAuth 2.0 (deprecated); successor Google Health API uses Google OAuth 2.0 scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/googlehealth*
fitbit_web_api.rate_limits: Legacy 150 req/hour/user (secondary source); Google Health API UNVERIFIED
fitbit_web_api.webhooks: Legacy Subscriptions API; Google Health API has notify-only auto-subscribing webhooks
data_restrictions: Legacy Fitbit Web API deprecated September 2026
Fitbit tokens do not carry over; users must re-consent via Google OAuth; avoid dual-linking
Google Health API terms/AI restrictions/OAuth verification UNVERIFIED (policies page 404)
fitbit_web_api.approval_required: Google Cloud project + OAuth consent; verification likely for health scopes (UNVERIFIED)
fitbit_web_api.notes: Google Health API data types: exercise sessions, HR (1s), HRV, resting HR, altitude (1-min), floors; no GPS/route data type found (data-types page last updated 2026-09-28).

mapy_com.auth: API key per project (developer.mapy.com account); billing via Seznam Penezenka
mapy_com.rate_limits: Credit-metered: Basic 250k free credits/month; Extended 10M free/month; overage 1.60 CZK/1k credits with volume tiers down to 0.2 CZK/1k. Tile 1, geocode 4, route 4, matrix10x10 40, elevation 4 credits. Hard rate limits UNVERIFIED.
data_restrictions: No storing or caching of tiles or API results (T&C 4.6.2)
No scraping (4.6.2)
Mapy map data must not be combined with other map data (2.5.2)
Extended tariff: public, free, only Mapy data, attribution, catalogue listing, annual affidavit
Secure API key; no third-party keys (4.1-4.2)
Terms effective 2025-06-01
mapy_com.attribution: Clickable Mapy.com logo (>=30px on map, >=20px for routing/geocoding-only) linking to https://mapy.com/; copyright text 'Seznam.cz a.s. and others' linking to https://api.mapy.com/copyright when map displayed
mapy_com.rn_library: No SDK; react-native-maps UrlTile or @maplibre/maplibre-react-native for tiles + REST
mapy_com.notes: Tiles: basic, outdoor (tourist), aerial, winter, names-overlay. Routing routeType foot_hiking (added 2025-09-23) prefers marked trails; up to 15 waypoints; GeoJSON/polyline. Elevation up to 256 points. No 'list trails near point' endpoint found.

openstreetmap.auth: None for public Overpass; identifying User-Agent required
openstreetmap.rate_limits: Public overpass-api.de: <10,000 queries/day and <1 GB/day; for ongoing app use ~100x less (~100 queries, 10 MB/day); slot-based per IP; 429/406 -> wait 30s; default timeout 180s, 512 MiB
data_restrictions: Commercial use should use self-hosted or paid Overpass servers
No parallel scripts; cache results; no bbox-stitching world scrapes
ODbL share-alike: publicly distributed substantial extracts are Derivative Databases
Elevation: OpenTopoData public 100 locations/request, 1 call/s, 1000 calls/day
Elevation: Open-Elevation free 1000 requests/month; ~500 coords/month/IP keyless; paid EUR 5.99-59.99/mo
Elevation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30/90 free, reproduction/distribution permitted, mandatory notice
openstreetmap.attribution: '(c) OpenStreetMap contributors' linked to https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright (collapsible after 5s on interactive maps). Copernicus: '(c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.'
openstreetmap.rn_library: Server-side fetch to Overpass (Supabase function + geohash cache); map display via @maplibre/maplibre-react-native or react-native-maps
openstreetmap.notes: Hiking routes: relations type=route + route=hiking|foot, network=iwn|nwn|rwn|lwn, name, ref, osmc:symbol, distance, ascent/descent; difficulty via sac_scale on ways. Example: relation["type"="route"]["route"~"^(hiking|foot)$"](around:10000,LAT,LON); out tags bb;

data_restrictions: Terms (updated 2025-12-17) prohibit automated queries and scraping/mining data
No commercial use without express written consent
No copying/republishing materials without written consent
Bot protection via DataDome
alltrails.rn_library: None; do not use unofficial wrappers
alltrails.approval_required: Only via bespoke business partnership (examples: Garmin, COROS, OpenAI ChatGPT app 2025-11-20, Anthropic Claude)
alltrails.notes: Conclusion: not a viable data source. Affiliate program exists (page 403, contents UNVERIFIED) but provides no known data access.

data_restrictions: No public API; partner access for selected established GPS/wearable manufacturers
komoot.notes: Owned by Bending Spoons. Support article returned 403; wording from search snippet.

outdooractive.auth: API key + project key; test keys available
data_restrictions: B2B only (entrepreneurs); provider approval before public deployment
Content must be refreshed at least every 24 hours
Pages with API content must carry robots noindex
No mass downloads
API Terms dated 2023-08-14
outdooractive.attribution: Outdooractive logo linking to homepage in imprint; source, author and photographer credits in detail views; license info
outdooractive.approval_required: Yes; commercial contract, pricing not published
outdooractive.notes: Tour geometry/elevation availability inferred, verify in Data Model docs.

data_restrictions: Data API deprecated late 2020; onX declines new requests
hiking_project.notes: Shut down; applies to Mountain Project and MTB Project too.

us_nps.auth: API key (X-Api-Key header or api_key param)
us_nps.rate_limits: 1,000 requests/hour; exceeding blocks key for 1 hour
data_restrictions: Subject to NPS disclaimer page (not fetched)
US only
No trails endpoint with geometry
us_nps.notes: Endpoints include parks, activities, thingstodo, places, alerts, campgrounds, events, articles. Good for POIs/alerts flavour, not trail geometry.
